# Test: press DOWN and check if Blue[0] changes
def extract_black_pattern(frame_ascii, r_start, c_start, height=5, width=5):
    lines = frame_ascii.split('\n')
    pattern = []
    for r in range(r_start, r_start + height):
        row = ''
        for c in range(c_start, c_start + width):
            row += '1' if lines[r][c] == 'B' else '0'
        pattern.append(row)
    return tuple(pattern)

# Current state
before_blue0 = extract_black_pattern(current_frame.ascii, 41, 15)
before_pink0 = extract_black_pattern(current_frame.ascii, 52, 15)

# Press DOWN
action(['DOWN'])

# Check after
after_blue0 = extract_black_pattern(current_frame.ascii, 41, 15)
after_pink0 = extract_black_pattern(current_frame.ascii, 52, 15)

print(f"Blue[0] changed: {before_blue0 != after_blue0}")
print(f"  Before: {''.join(before_blue0)}")
print(f"  After:  {''.join(after_blue0)}")
print(f"Pink[0] changed: {before_pink0 != after_pink0}")
print(f"  Before: {''.join(before_pink0)}")
print(f"  After:  {''.join(after_pink0)}")

# Check all blue and pink symbols
blue_positions = [(41, 15 + i*7) for i in range(5)]
pink_positions = [(52, 15 + i*7) for i in range(5)]

# Get patterns from before (previous_frame)
before_ascii = previous_frame.ascii
print("\nAll symbols changed by DOWN:")
for i, (r, c) in enumerate(blue_positions):
    before_pat = extract_black_pattern(before_ascii, r, c)
    after_pat = extract_black_pattern(current_frame.ascii, r, c)
    if before_pat != after_pat:
        print(f"  Blue[{i}] changed")

for i, (r, c) in enumerate(pink_positions):
    before_pat = extract_black_pattern(before_ascii, r, c)
    after_pat = extract_black_pattern(current_frame.ascii, r, c)
    if before_pat != after_pat:
        print(f"  Pink[{i}] changed")

# Check white marker positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
print("\nWhite marker positions:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'W':
        r_min = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        c_min = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        print(f"  id={n['id']}, top=({r_min}, {c_min})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
